arguments.analysis_summary: Project-only Gaussian plan for a neutral singlet (charge 0, multiplicity 1) frequency calculation preserving the explicitly reported method exactly: functional M08-HX, basis pcseg-2, integration grid UltraFine. All reported literals are retained verbatim; no settings were substituted or added (dispersion, solvent, and GFN fields do not apply and are left null). No read-only inspection tool was available in this session, so the registry registration status of M08-HX, pcseg-2, and UltraFine could not be verified; settings are therefore treated as unknown_unverified, and readiness is blocked_unverified_setting pending host verification. This plan is not previewed, executed, or scientifically validated; no coordinates, native input, or shell commands were created.
